name: elizaos-plugin-autonomo
description: elizaOS plugin for Autonomo: an agent finds the right paid API, sees its price and pays for a call in USDG or $AUTONOMO on Robinhood Chain, or USDC on Base, within spending caps.
author: Autonomo (https://autonomo.fun)

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run typecheck:v1 && npm test

AUTONOMO_WALLET_KEY.description: Private key of a wallet made just for the agent, holding only what it may spend. Without it the agent can find APIs and check prices, not pay.

AUTONOMO_PAY_WITH.description: Token to pay with: usdg, autonomo or auto (USDG first, then $AUTONOMO).

AUTONOMO_MAX_USDG_PER_CALL.description: The most one call may cost in USDG.

AUTONOMO_MAX_AUTONOMO_PER_CALL.description: The most one call may cost in $AUTONOMO.

AUTONOMO_DAILY_USDG.description: The most to spend per UTC day in USDG.

AUTONOMO_DAILY_AUTONOMO.description: The most to spend per UTC day in $AUTONOMO.

AUTONOMO_BORRO_ACCOUNT.description: Address of a Borro credit line to borrow from when the wallet is short of USDG.

AUTONOMO_MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS.description: Longer API answers are cut before they reach the model or the chat.
